class.name: VirtualGeometryData
class.description: Holds the cluster DAG, the resident root pages, a coarse fallback for every source surface, and the streaming stats of one virtualized mesh. The paged geometry lives in a [code].ngm[/code] sidecar named by [member ngm_path]; that file is not a Godot resource and has no UID. An [ArrayMesh] keeps this resource as [member ArrayMesh.virtual_geometry]. Any surface mutation detaches it before the next frame. Assigning the same surfaces back, which is what loading does, leaves it in place.

members.member: Impostor card descriptors. Empty until cards are generated.
Number of clusters in the DAG.
One [Mesh] surface array per source surface. Eligible surfaces contain the root cut as ordinary vertex and index arrays. Ineligible surfaces are empty arrays of the same length.
Number of levels in the cluster DAG.
Little-endian cluster groups followed by the bounding-volume hierarchy nodes.
Resource layout version. The current version is [code]1[/code].
Number of cluster groups in the DAG.
Path of the [code].ngm[/code] sidecar that stores the paged geometry.
SHA-256 of the [code].ngm[/code] file bytes. 32 bytes when set. This is the hash of the file, not of the source mesh.
Number of pages in the [code].ngm[/code] sidecar.
Page budget in bytes used when the DAG was built. It covers the page header, the cluster records, the vertices and triangles, and the alignment padding, so every stored page fits.
Raw payloads of the resident root pages, in page order.
Cluster ids selected for the ray-tracing proxy.
Position epsilon of the ray-tracing proxy.
Geometric error of the ray-tracing proxy.
Little-endian unsigned 32-bit indices of the ray-tracing proxy, four bytes each.
Groups of four integers per ray-tracing part: vertex offset, vertex count, index offset, and index count.
Positions of the ray-tracing proxy, tightly packed 32-bit xyz, including in double-precision builds.
Groups of two integers per part and surface, part-major and relative to that part: first index and index count. Legacy surfaces store a first index and a count of 0.
Bone influences stored per vertex in the page file skinning section: 0 for an unskinned mesh, otherwise 4 or 8.
Number of triangles in the source clusters.
Bytes of the source positions and indices: 12 bytes per position and 4 bytes per index.
One byte per source surface. [code]1[/code] means the surface was virtualized, and [code]0[/code] means it stayed a legacy surface.
One value per source surface. [code]0[/code] means the surface was virtualized, or that import has not recorded a reason yet.
